title: llama.cpp serving
summary: Take a GGUF from a file on disk to a tuned, pre-tested, served model on a consumer gaming GPU: probe the box, choose the backend by silicon, do the VRAM maths, tune, smoke-test and write the unit. Every number carries the measurement that produced it, and every tool refuses the action that would produce a lie.

assumptions.claim: there is a discrete GPU to put layers on
assumptions.resolution: no GPU means the CPU build and models under ~4B; the pack still applies, its numbers do not

assumptions.claim: the GPU is AMD, so the advice is Vulkan-versus-ROCm and -ncmoe
assumptions.resolution: on NVIDIA use the CUDA build and --n-cpu-moe for every -ncmoe example; on Intel use Vulkan

assumptions.claim: the tuning needs at most 8 GiB of VRAM
assumptions.resolution: a smaller card will not hold the offload numbers either; start from tools/lcpp-recommend.py

assumptions.claim: 8 GiB is the card this was tuned on, so -ncmoe 26 is the wrong number anywhere else
assumptions.resolution: recompute the offload with tools/lcpp-recommend.py: with more VRAM fewer experts leave the card, and the model may fit whole

assumptions.claim: the card is idle before a measurement
assumptions.resolution: wait for whatever is loaded to unload; a measurement on a busy card is not a measurement

assumptions.claim: the thread count is the physical core count, six on the machine this was written on
assumptions.resolution: use the count this machine reports, not 6: hyperthreads cost throughput in llama.cpp

assumptions.claim: port 8115 is free for a bench server
assumptions.resolution: pick a free port and pass it to tools/lcpp-serve.sh; the unit it writes must name the same one

assumptions.claim: system RAM can hold the offloaded experts, about 20 GiB for a 35B Q4
assumptions.resolution: with less RAM drop to a smaller quant or a model whose experts fit; -ncmoe assumes the overflow lands somewhere

assumptions.claim: the weights being served live on an internal disk, not a USB drive
assumptions.resolution: move the file being served to the internal disk first; loading a weight over USB costs more than the quant saves
